about: Network UPS Tools, software that monitors UPS power supplies and shuts computers down safely on a power cut.

prs.title: Shutdown reaches every UPS in order
prs.broken: On a setup with several UPS units, a shutdown of all devices only reached the ones in the first shutdown group. The rest never got the command.
prs.changed: The device list now restarts for each shutdown group, so every unit is reached in order.
prs.matters: On a power cut, all UPS units shut down as configured, not just the first.
